name: TestDataAgent
description: Reads business scenarios and generates positive/negative/boundary test data variants per scenario, in parallel, with a 3-tier fallback (NS HTTP, alt model, deterministic Python). Phase 0: removes active security-probe payloads from negative/boundary data unless the safety policy allows probes (never on prod/unspecified), reporting each removal; writes test_data.json as a schema_version 2 envelope. Phase 1: variants removed by the test_generation caps are counted per scenario in capped_variants (traceability reason 'budget').

inputs.name: comprehension/business_scenarios.json
inputs.description: Scenarios to generate data for — MissingInputError if absent

inputs.name: comprehension/interaction_catalog.json
inputs.description: Preferred source of field_name hints ({scenario_id: [fill_field_name,...]}) for matching Test Data field names to real UI intents

inputs.name: test_creation/intents.yaml
inputs.description: Legacy field_name-hint fallback when interaction_catalog.json is absent — reads each fill-intent's source_scenarios (now populated by SemanticMapAgent's backlink instead of the unwired legacy ArtifactGeneratorAgent testcases pass)

inputs.name: safety
inputs.description: Resolved SafetyPolicy (security_probes_allowed); loaded from project.yaml when absent

outputs.name: coverage_pct
outputs.description: Percent of scenarios with a usable positive dataset

outputs.name: security_probe_drops
outputs.description: Iterations/variants removed because security probes are not allowed
